hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *.py ]]; then for d in backend bot; do if [[ "$file" == *"/$d/"* ]]; then s="${file%%/$d/*}/$d"; (cd "$s" && uv run ruff format "$file" && uv run ruff check --fix "$file") 2>/dev/null; break; fi; done; fi || true

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" =~ \.(ts|html|scss|css)$ ]] && [[ "$file" == */frontend/* ]]; then s="${file%%/frontend/*}/frontend"; (cd "$s" && npx prettier --write "$file" --log-level silent) 2>/dev/null; fi || true

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$file" == *orm.py ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"orm.py modifie - pense a creer une migration Alembic si des colonnes ou tables ont change (/db-migrate)"}}'; fi || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]main'; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Push direct sur main bloque. Developpe sur la branche claude/plan-v2-architecture-C5ExA."}'; fi || true
